purpose: Validate a native save result by reconciling file identity, save record, run reference, and persistence states.
trigger: Use after a native .scdoc save when the file digest, save record, and run reference are available for checking.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Positional path argument: path to one native .scdoc output.

inputs.name: expected_sha256
inputs.description: Positional expected_sha256 argument: expected SHA-256 digest.

inputs.name: save_record
inputs.description: Positional caller-supplied save record with matching run_ref, status=passed, and sha256; the helper does not observe the save event.

inputs.name: run_ref
inputs.description: Positional current run reference used to bind save_record.

preconditions: Call check_native_save_result(path, expected_sha256, save_record, run_ref) with all four arguments positionally.
path ends in .scdoc and is a regular file.
save_record belongs to run_ref, has status=passed, and has the expected hash; the record is independently supplied by the caller.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: passed/failed based on supplied record and file identity.

outputs.name: run_ref
outputs.description: Run identity used to bind save_record.

outputs.name: native_save_observed
outputs.description: Always false; this host check does not observe the save event.

postconditions: The result reports file/save-record consistency only.
native_save_observed=false and native_reopen=not_tested; no native runtime claim is made.

implementation.target_environment: Windows host-side Python helper; it checks one .scdoc identity and supplied save record without opening or controlling SpaceClaim.
implementation.notes: Call validation_host_actions.check_native_save_result(path, expected_sha256, save_record, run_ref) with positional arguments. Invalid extension, run reference, save record, digest, or file inputs raise ValidationInputError, a ValueError subclass; hash mismatch or zero-byte output returns status=failed. The helper does not perform/save/reopen a model or claim native-save observation.

ambiguity_checks: This host helper does not resolve CAD objects or observe a save event; the caller must supply the exact path, run_ref, and save record.
If the file identity or independently observed save record is unavailable, return needs_manual_review rather than infer native-save or runtime state.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; this operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: The path extension, run_ref, save_record correlation, digest, or file identity is invalid.
failure_modes.detection: check_native_save_result or its identity check raises ValidationInputError, which is a ValueError subclass.
failure_modes.safe_state: No native-save or runtime claim is emitted; preserve the host-only boundary and return needs_manual_review to the caller.

failure_modes.condition: The file hash differs from the expected hash or the output is zero bytes.
failure_modes.detection: The helper returns a flat result with status=failed and save_record_consistent=false.
failure_modes.safe_state: Retain the failed consistency result and do not promote native_save or native_reopen evidence.

recovery.action: Catch ValidationInputError/ValueError, correct the caller-supplied path, digest, run_ref, or save_record, and retry only with explicit evidence; otherwise return needs_manual_review.
Inspect the exact output bytes and supplied save record; do not rewrite the expected hash or infer a native save/reopen event.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare its operation ID with the catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, candidate-only, and declares one independent validation_visual_review action.

validation.method: Compare the exact positional host-call interface, flat result fields, and ValidationInputError/ValueError boundary with the linked guidance file.
validation.expected: The contract exposes the same fields and preserves needs_manual_review, unsupported-control, and no-overclaim boundaries.

validation.method: Call validation_host_actions.check_native_save_result(path, expected_sha256, save_record, run_ref) only after the caller has supplied the independent save record.
validation.expected: The result reports file/save-record consistency only.

evidence_level.notes: Deterministic host property/file checks only. Caller must independently provide trustworthy measured/runtime observations.
